omniprevalence.hook: Made from omni- + prevalence. prevalence goes back to Middle French prévalence.

omnisignificance.sense: noun: The quality of being omnisignificant.
omnisignificance.hook: Made from omni- + significance. significance goes back to Middle French significance.

omnitolerance.sense: noun: The quality of being omnitolerant.

omeletteless.hook: Made from omelette + -less. omelette goes back to French omelette.
